ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar will offer students a substantive survey of the area of rhetorical studies known as visual rhetoric. By the end of the course students will have been introduced to approaches, concepts/theories, and methods for the study of visual rhetoric, as well as explored the history of the study of visual rhetoric. While the course assumes some familiarity with humanistic approaches to the study of communication, students need not have had previous graduate coursework in rhetoric to enroll.
